Welcome to Elmtree Infant & Nursery School
Elmtree is an aspirational and inclusive school. At the heart of our vision is educational excellence for all, where each child can flourish and live out the spirit of childhood.
We want to enable Elmtree children to flourish by providing a safe, happy and stimulating environment, where they receive high-quality teaching and leave us with a love of learning as thoughtful, caring and confident future citizens.
Through an ambitious and enriching curriculum, we work together to support and inspire our children to learn, develop and grow. We are committed to fostering a nurturing and dynamic learning environment where every child can thrive. Our dedicated staff are here to provide a rich educational experience, tailored to meet the needs and aspirations of each child. We believe in creating a strong partnership with parents and the wider community, to ensure that we are all working towards the common goal of helping Elmtree children achieve their full potential and live out the spirit of childhood in their time with us.
We are a multi-cultural, small school with big dreams!
Look around our website and see how Elmtree children thrive.
Associated Values
We strive to achieve excellence for ourselves and for others in all that we do. We believe that no challenge is too great.
We keep trying and have the strength and courage to face problems.
We have the confidence to ask why and always want to know more.
We care and support each other and celebrate our diverse community.

Educational Visits
We enjoy taking children on school trips to enhance their learning of a topic. The Governors of Elmtree have agreed the following policy with regard to charging for educational activities. "Educational outings from school will rely on voluntary contributions towards the cost of each activity on a pro-rata basis. If contributions are, however, not forthcoming then the trip will be cancelled." If there is any financial difficulty, the Headteacher is happy to discuss payment with parents.

Curriculum
Elmtree Infant and Nursery School
Curriculum Statement of Intent
At Elmtree Infant and Nursery School we have designed a broad, comprehensive curriculum to inspire enthusiasm for life-long learning, that is ambitious for all. We ensure that the learning is meaningful, rich and relevant for all of our children to give them the best chance of success whilst supporting their well-being and happiness. Our curriculum enables the children to become successful, independent and motivated learners, who value their individuality. We provide an environment where every child really matters and offer first-hand learning experiences which allow our children to develop interpersonal skills.
We offer a rich range of opportunities that provide meaningful and relevant learning to enable each child to be the best they can be regardless of ability. The planning and implementation of our curriculum supports a strong impact on pupils learning. We acknowledge all aspects of their development and inspire children to be curious, ambitious and inquisitive learners in order to equip them with the necessary skills to meet the challenges of their future lives with confidence and resilience. The impact of the curriculum pupils receive is strong, including for disadvantaged pupils and those with an SEND.
Through our Elmtree Values, the PSHE curriculum, character education and assemblies we encourage children to celebrate diversity whilst being inclusive and respectful. This enables them to understand how they can positively contribute to the society that they live in.
We work in harmony with parents, families and the local community.
Our desire is for our children to leave Elmtree Infant and Nursery School with a sense of pride and belonging which will allow them to continue to have high expectations and constantly pursue excellence.
If you would like to find out more about the curriculum your child is following please speak, in the first instance, to your child's class teacher.

JR Sports - Breakfast and after school care
JR Sports Group are providing before and after school care every day the school is open. Our aim is to deliver a top quality, Ofsted registered provision, with a range of stimulating activities in a safe, secure, and fun environment, providing an outstanding service for busy parents.
Our staff will adapt each day based on children’s needs or the weather, but timings and structure of the days will be consistent. Activities will be designed to fit in with the schools termly theme and include arts & crafts, baking, sports, Lego, games, quiet reading, and general free play.
7:45am – 8:45am = £5.50 a session
3:00pm –6pm = £14 a session
3:00pm – 4:15pm = £9 a session

About Us
Application Form
Nursery Team 2026/27
We welcome you and your child to our Nursery. We are always happy to talk to you when you drop off or pick up your child or we can be contacted on 01494 771474. Mrs Ohene is our Headteacher, Miss Gettings is our Early Years Leader and Miss Trower is our Nursery Lead.
We offer Nursery places for children starting the term after their third birthday. Each child is offered a maximum of five, three hour funded sessions per week. Additional nursery sessions may also be available at an extra cost of £16.00 per session.
A child can do either 5 morning or 5 afternoon sessions to access their 15 fully funded hours. We do also offer some 30 hour funded sessions.
The Nursery children wear a uniform. The uniform consists of a red sweatshirt/cardigan a white shirt/polo shirt, grey or black trousers/skirt. If your child is still toilet training then black/grey tracksuit bottoms are permissible. Footwear that is manageable for the children to take on and off themselves. Our uniform is available from - KL Schoolwear (www.klschoolwear.co.uk)
email: orders@klschoolwear.co.uk Snack Time
We provide snack during the sessions. We encourage the children to select from a choice of seasonal fruit or vegetables. We also ask parents to contribute crackers/breadsticks/dried fruit to add variety to the snack selection. Milk or water is also offered.
Nursery Children have PE on Wednesdays. If your child attends all day, morning or afternoon on this day please send them to school in suitable clothing. Please tie long hair back and remove ear piercings.
Children who attend for a full day will need to bring in a packed lunch from home. Continence We understand that not all the children who attend the Nursery are able to manage their own personal toileting, we are happy to work with you and your child to manage this important stage at a pace they can cope with. Please ensure you pack wipes, nappies, nappy sacks and any spare clothes your child may need if toilet training. Safeguarding and Welfare The safeguarding and welfare requirements of all children is our main priority.
